acquisition method: looped 18 narrow window data independent acquisition (DIA) tandem mass spectrometry scans
alkylation reagent: followed by alkylation with 11 mM iodoacetamide at room temperature
alkylation concentration: followed by alkylation with 11 mM iodoacetamide at room temperature
cleavage agent: trypsin digestion was carried out overnight at 37 °C
collision energy: following each survey scan using 60 sec exclusion for previously sampled peptide peaks using normalized collision energy 30
fractionation method: Twelve concatenated fractions were analyzed with LC-MS/MS for each TMT experiment
instrument: electrospray quadrupole-orbital ion trap mass spectrometer (Q Exactive Plus, Thermo, San Jose, CA)
ionization type: interfaced with an electrospray quadrupole-orbital ion trap mass spectrometer
labeling: using tandem mass tag (TMT) chemical labeling experiments
reduction reagent: The proteins were reduced with 4.5 mM DTT at 60 °C
reduction concentration: The proteins were reduced with 4.5 mM DTT at 60 °C
